name: Input_Init
comment: Creates DirectInput, the keyboard and mouse devices and scans the joysticks

name: Input_EnableAxis
comment: Axes 0-11 belong to the two joysticks, 12-14 to the mouse

name: Input_Update
comment: Once per frame: polls keyboard, joysticks and mouse and records press/release times

name: Input_InitJoysticks
comment: Up to two joysticks via joyGetDevCaps; six axes each, POV hat flagged

name: Input_CreateMouse
comment: Mouse axes 12 (x), 13 (y), 14 (wheel) in relative mode

name: Input_PollKeyboard
comment: Buffered DirectInput key events plus the immediate key state; each key has a 7-dword record {?, lastDown, down, downTime, upTime, pressCount, doubleTap}

name: Input_PollJoysticks
comment: joyGetPosEx per stick; the POV hat is mapped onto four virtual buttons

name: Input_SetAxisRange
proto: void Input_SetAxisRange(int axis, int min, int max, float deadZone)

name: Svc_DebugPrintf
comment: Platform service printf: formats into g_szDebugBuffer and OutputDebugString

name: Services_InitPlatformTable
comment: Win95 platform service table: debug printf, stdMemory alloc/free/realloc, timeGetTime, stdFile I/O, handle memory stubs

name: stdMemory_Alloc
proto: void * stdMemory_Alloc(uint size, char * file, int line)

name: stdMemory_Realloc
proto: void * stdMemory_Realloc(void * p, uint size, char * file, int line)

name: D3D_Enumerate
comment: Queries IDirect3D from DirectDraw and enumerates the 3D drivers into g_D3dDrivers (0x22c bytes each)

name: D3D_SelectDriver
comment: Creates the Direct3D device, z-buffer, viewport, execute buffer and picks the texture formats

name: D3D_SetTextureLimits
proto: void D3D_SetTextureLimits(int minW, int minH, int maxSize, int d)

name: D3D_AddVertices
comment: Copies 32-byte TLVERTEX records into the execute buffer

name: D3D_BeginInstructions
comment: Emits the PROCESSVERTICES instruction for everything added so far

name: D3D_AddTriangles
comment: Emits TRIANGLE instructions, grouped by texture handle, switching render state and texture as needed

name: D3D_ExecuteBuffer
comment: Terminates and executes the buffer on the device

name: D3D_SetRenderFlags
comment: Emits STATERENDER changes: 0x8000 z compare, 0x600 blending, 0x1800 filtering/perspective, 0x40 fog

name: D3D_ResetTextures
comment: Lua ResetTextures: frees every texture record

name: D3D_CreateTexture
proto: int D3D_CreateTexture(void * surface, void * texture, int usePalette, int colorKey)
comment: Builds a 0x98-byte texture record {sysSurface, vidSurface, ..., +0x74 handle, +0x78 valid, +0x80 w, +0x88 h, +0x88 size, +0x8c frameStamp, +0x90 prev, +0x94 next}; scales to the driver's size limits and converts 8-bit sources to 16-bit

name: D3D_InitRenderState
comment: Fills an execute buffer with the initial STATERENDER list derived from the driver capability bits

name: D3D_EvictTexture
comment: Frees a texture not used this frame (best size match) to make room, or all idle textures
